sloka: अभिषेकाय रामस्य सह तिष्ठन्ति पार्थिवैः ।त्वरयस्व महाराजं यथा समुदितेऽहनि ॥२-१४-४२॥
transliteration: abhiṣekāya rāmasya saha tiṣṭhanti pārthivaiḥ ।tvarayasva mahārājaṁ yathā samudite'hani ॥2-14-42॥

translations.english: Hasten the maharaja as Rama has to be installed in the kingdom as soon as the day breaks under the conjunction of the sacred Pushya star.
